info.description: Musebook as merchant for subscription and API-credit charges, settled through the musebook token-backed credit provider. STATUS: UNDER REVIEW, NOT AVAILABLE. The musebook provider is submitted for review in pay-kit; validate_credit_providers returns Unavailable for it on every network, currency, and payment intent, and the merchant default is an empty provider list (stablecoin-only). This document describes the merchant configuration contract only: the provider exposes no live HTTP payment endpoints, and no deposits, credits, or charges move through it until the pay-kit review accepts the exact implementation and configuration. Merchant configuration (pay-kit): credit_providers: ["musebook"] selects the reviewed configuration by name once accepted; a name never authorizes an arbitrary program, hook configuration, or issuer credential. Flow once accepted: the customer deposits original SPL tokens (USDC first) into the vault of their per-(owner, mint) ledger and receives credits; owner and issuer co-sign an authorization binding payee, exact voucher signer, distribution hash, total funding cap, nonce, and funding-expiry slot; charges fund through V2 payment channels with preFund/postDistribute hooks derived from the stored authorization (never customer-supplied hook JSON); refunds restore credits only after the actual refund tokens are recovered into the vault (a zero refund restores zero credits). Tokens: original SPL Token only (no Token-2022, no wrapped SOL). Networks: local evidence only at submission; devnet and mainnet are not claimed. Sponsorship: none. Implementation under review: themusebook/musebook-credit-provider. Companion pay-kit draft PR link: TBD.
